description: This file defines the class ProspectListFormBase, which provides methods for rendering and handling forms related to prospect lists in the SuiteCRM system, including form creation, validation, and saving data.

classes.name: ProspectListFormBase
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate and process prospect list forms, including rendering HTML forms and saving form data into the database.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form for creating or editing a prospect list, including form header, body, and footer.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Builds the main body content of the form, including input fields for prospect list properties and necessary JavaScript for validation.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission, saves the prospect list data into the database, and performs redirection or returns the bean object.
